name: Helios Intelligence
long_description:
Helios is building a molecular body test from a single drop of blood. Our at-home test measures more than 1,000 biomarkers and turns them into a living model of the body—designed to show what is happening now, surface risk earlier, and become more useful with every test.

By combining longitudinal molecular data with labs, wearables, health records, and outcomes, we are building toward a world model of human biology. Our goal is to simulate all of human health and use that intelligence to help people perform, recover, and live longer.

launches.title: Helios Intelligence – The highest-resolution picture of your health: 1,000+ biomarkers from a drop of blood, at home
launches.tagline: Measure 1,000+ biomarkers at home and see how each of your organs is aging
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=127394&key=user_uploads/33203/7d4e91a7-111e-4e10-a69d-2003ee8aafea)

**TL;DR: Helios is an at-home blood test that measures 1,000+ biomarkers from a single drop of blood. You get scores for 70+ organs and pathways, your risk for hundreds of diseases, and a plan to improve them that you track by retesting. Jonathan and I invented SHERLOCK, the first FDA-authorized CRISPR test, and have co-founded biotech companies that raised $400M+, two of them acquired by public companies (OraSure, Ginkgo). Yousef is a physician-scientist at MGH and Harvard Medical School. We're launching first with a small cohort of clinics, and the waitlist is open to clinics and individuals at [myhelios.com](http://myhelios.com).**\
\
<https://youtu.be/YLxoeVdyzSI?si=wRpzzG0XXfyGpGu5>

Hey everyone! Omar here, with my cofounders Jonathan Gootenberg and Yousef Badran.

## **Why we built this**

Healthcare mostly waits until you're sick. You see a doctor when something hurts, get a standard panel that checks a few dozen things, and often hear that everything looks normal. But heart disease, diabetes and dementia can start developing years or decades before you feel anything or a standard lab value moves, and by then they are much harder to treat.

Jonathan and I have worked on this problem for most of our careers. In grad school we invented SHERLOCK, a CRISPR-based diagnostic, and our company Sherlock Biosciences got the first FDA authorization for a CRISPR test during COVID. In our lab at Harvard we then studied aging, the proteins in blood that track it, and how to use machine learning to predict future health from them. Proteins come from every organ, so measuring a thousand of them shows how each system is aging and where disease is starting, often long before symptoms. A large body of research backs this up, but the technology has stayed inside research labs and pharma companies.

Yousef, an internal medicine physician-scientist and gastroenterologist at MGH and Harvard Medical School, joined us to bring it into clinical care. We want to change how medicine catches disease, and we're starting with a test that shows how your body is doing today and where it's heading over the decades ahead.

## **What you get**

* **1,000+ biomarkers** from one drop of blood, collected at home with a small device on your arm. No needle draw, no lab visit.
* **70+ scores** across your organs and pathways: heart, vessels, brain, liver, kidneys, immune system, metabolism, inflammation, and more, each with its own age.
* **Risk for hundreds of diseases**, up to a decade before they would show up in standard care.
* **An AI agent** that explains your results, builds you an action plan tied to the scores you most need to move, and tracks your progress. It learns more about you each time you retest.
* **Retesting over time**, so you can see what is actually changing and whether the plan is working.

Results come back in 2-4 weeks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=127394&key=user_uploads/33203/b3294786-def0-4f3f-a9c7-d224f5ff9a59)

## **Where this goes**

We're building the test into a full longevity service: testing, physician review, and a plan you follow and re-measure. Every test also adds to what we expect will be the world's largest longitudinal proteomics dataset. We're using it to build world models of human health that simulate how your body is aging and predict which interventions will work for you. Long term, we want to simulate human health well enough to help people live longer, healthier lives.

## **Where we are**

We're launching with a small cohort of clinics this fall. Doctors order the test for their customers and review the report with them. Individuals can join the waitlist now at [myhelios.com](http://myhelios.com) and get first access.

## **Who we are**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=127394&key=user_uploads/33203/8be7aa0d-f04b-4db5-b750-cf9927c44cf7)

* **Omar:** MIT, PhD at MIT/Harvard, former Harvard Medical School faculty. Co-founded 7 biotech companies that have raised $400M+, including Sherlock Biosciences (acquired by OraSure, NASDAQ: OSUR) and Proof Diagnostics (acquired by Ginkgo Bioworks, NYSE: DNA).
* **Jonathan:** Harvard Medical School faculty, PhD in Systems Biology from Harvard with Feng Zhang and Aviv Regev at the Broad. Co-founded Sherlock Biosciences, Tome Biosciences, Proof Diagnostics, Terrain Biosciences, Dopper Biosciences, Transit Therapeutics, and Monet Labs.
* **Yousef:** Internal medicine physician-scientist and gastroenterologist at Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School, focused on immunology and aging, with expertise in drug development and biotech company building.
*

1. **Intro us to clinics.** We're adding launch partners: longevity, concierge, functional medicine, primary care and cardiology practices.
2. **Offer it as an employee benefit.** Want this for your team? Reply or email us.
3. **Partner with us.** Telehealth companies and health apps that want to offer this to their members.
4. **Join the waitlist.** [myhelios.com](http://myhelios.com), for yourself or your clinic.
